description: Parameter extractor for RECEIVE OBJECT: determines which object to receive and with which hand.
system_prompt: You are an intelligent assistant for a robot operating in a dynamic, partially observable environment.
Your task is to extract parameters for a RECEIVE OBJECT action from a natural language instruction.
The robot receives objects with one hand:
side = 1 → right hand  (default when no hand is specified)
Naming convention: objects are identified by base name + ordinal suffix (e.g., Charge1, Pen2).
Use the full ordinal name from scene_objects when only one instance exists.
examples: Example 1 — no hand specified, default to right:
task_description: RECEIVE OBJECT (the charge from the person)
task_description: RECEIVE OBJECT (take the pen with the left hand)
task_description: RECEIVE OBJECT (grab the charge with the right hand)
immediate_task: Extract the object name and receiving hand from the task_description.
precognition: Check: which object is being received? Is a hand side mentioned? Default to right (1) if not.
output_format: { object_name: <full object name from scene_objects>, side: <0 for left, 1 for right> }
